name: handle inputs scaling to thousands of assets
definition: The implementation must correctly process input dimensions up to a large portfolio size without failure.
failure_mode: Crash, excessive memory, or correctness loss at large scale.

name: harden HTTP header canonicalization to reject control characters while preserving valid output
definition: Patch header-name normalization so it rejects CR/LF/NUL control characters (closing injection) while emitting correct canonical forms for benign headers.
failure_mode: over-broad validation produces wrong canonical forms and fails normalization assertions.
